bias.zh: 偏空 · 逼近 $321 低点

read.en: Broadcom fell 0.5% on Oct 23 to $321.68, trading between $320.23 and $327.70. It is below all its falling averages: 5-day ($330.3), 10-day ($338.3), 30-day ($349.6), 100-day ($374.5) and 200-day ($367.8). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 15 and below zero, with the histogram widening; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 13 ($358.43), and RSI is 34.

The close slipped to the bottom of the $321.4–324.1 support (Dec 17 and Oct 10, 2025 lows), and the $320.2 low undercut it intraday. Resistance is $324.1, then $330–331 (5-day, Oct 22 high) and $338–341 (10-day, Oct 20 high). Support is $320.2, then $314.1 (Jan 23 low) and $307–308.5. A close below $320 would open $314; a close above $331 would target $335–338.

r.en: Top of the Dec 17 and Oct 10, 2025 lows zone ($321.4–324.1)
